title: The intrinsically disordered protein NUPR1 binds to phospholipids.
authors: Estaras, Matias; Rizzuti, Bruno; Giudici, A Marcela; Poveda, Jose A; Iovanna, Juan L; Santofimia-Castano, Patricia; Neira, Jose L
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文研究无序蛋白NUPR1与磷脂的结合，涉及IDP对象和实验/模拟方法，但互作对象为脂质而非蛋白，缺乏PPI机制建模，对课题启发有限。
abstract: The nuclear protein 1 (NUPR1) is an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP) involved in stress-mediated cellular conditions, with an interactome including many other partner proteins, as well as nucleic acids. We wondered whether its great conformational flexibility and biological versatility could include interactions with lipids. Binding between NUPR1 and phosphatidylserine (PS) and phosphatidylinositol biphosphate (PIP2) was verified in cellulo by using proximity ligation assay (PLA) techniques in MiaPaCa-2 cells. Binding in vitro was assayed against PS, and against PS in a mixture with phosphatidylcholine (PC), and it was confirmed by using nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and biolayer interferometry (BLI). Furthermore, results in silico also showed the association between NUPR1 and the lipids, occurring in a mostly aspecific way on the membrane surface, but with a slight preference for the binding through the protein hot-spot regions: the most common interaction sites with other molecular species: around Ala33 and Thr68. All together, these techniques unambiguously indicate that NUPR1 was bound to lipids. We discuss the potential biological consequences of our findings, including the possible relevance of NUPR1 in participating in the stability of membrane organelles, as well as in modulating cellular signaling.
abstract_zh: 核蛋白1（NUPR1）是一种 intrinsically disordered protein (IDP)，参与应激介导的细胞状态，其相互作用组包括许多其他伙伴蛋白以及核酸。我们推测其巨大的构象灵活性和生物学多功能性可能包括与脂质的相互作用。通过使用 proximity ligation assay (PLA) 技术，在MiaPaCa-2细胞中验证了NUPR1与磷脂酰丝氨酸（PS）和磷脂酰肌醇二磷酸（PIP2）之间的结合。体外结合实验针对PS以及PS与磷脂酰胆碱（PC）的混合物进行了测定，并通过核磁共振（NMR）和生物层干涉法（BLI）确认。此外，in silico 结果也显示了NUPR1与脂质之间的关联，这种关联主要发生在膜表面，方式较为非特异性，但略微偏好通过蛋白热点区域结合：这些区域是与其它分子种类最常见的相互作用位点，位于Ala33和Thr68附近。综合这些技术，明确表明NUPR1与脂质结合。我们讨论了这些发现潜在的生物学后果，包括NUPR1可能参与膜细胞器稳定性以及调节细胞信号传导的相关性。
